page: Oracle Cloud Infrastructure VM.Standard.A1.Flex.2-16 is an Arm-based virtual machine configured with 2 dedicated vCPUs and 16.0 GB of memory. Driven by Ampere Altra Neoverse-N1 processors operating at a sustained 3.0 GHz, each vCPU maps directly to a physical core with one thread per core. The server configuration provides a generous memory allocation of 8.0 GB per core, while local storage is not bundled and hardware accelerators are absent. A single complimentary public IPv4 address is included.

Benchmark evaluations highlight the limitations of a low-core Arm topology in intensive computing tasks. The stress-ng single-core score achieves an average rating (1769.89), whereas multi-core throughput drops into the bottom 25% (3470.69). Geekbench results reflect lower-tier performance with a single-core score of 1117.0 and a multi-core score of 2004.0, while PassMark tests show low marks across physics, encryption, and overall CPU metrics. Memory bandwidth is measured at 25.13 GB/s for large uncached reads and 15.39 GB/s for writes, supporting 2.59 million Redis SET operations per second and 3.62 GB/s in static web serving throughput.

This server type yields practical cost efficiency for baseline services that require high RAM capacity without intense CPU resource demands. The primary tradeoff is the absence of local disks and limited raw compute power, rendering it ineffective for heavy parallel data processing or intensive cryptographic compilation. It is best applied to lightweight caching layers, development environments, intermediate staging tiers, and low-traffic web hosting.
description: Oracle Cloud Infrastructure VM.Standard.A1.Flex.2-16 is an Arm-based instance featuring 2 dedicated vCPUs on an Ampere Altra Neoverse-N1 processor clocked at 3.0 GHz, matched with 16.0 GB of RAM. Designed without bundled local storage or GPU accelerators, the instance provides 8.0 GB of memory per core and includes one complimentary public IPv4 address. Benchmark results demonstrate average single-core stress-ng performance paired with lower multi-core and PassMark marks due to the 2-core envelope. Memory bandwidth reaches 25.13 GB/s for uncached reads, enabling 2.59 million Redis SET operations per second and 3.62 GB/s of static web serving throughput. VM.Standard.A1.Flex.2-16 offers balanced efficiency for memory-heavy utilities, lightweight web serving, caching instances, and low-intensity development tasks.
